data.name: Lohit
data.gender_notes: Lohit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lohit is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is associated with the color red and crimson. In Hindu mythology, Lohit is the name of a demon or asura who is the god of fire and has the power to grant boons. He is also known as Agni, the god of fire. The name Lohit carries the meaning “Red, Crimson” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lohit usually hope their child will grow to embody red, crimson and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of passion, courage, and transformation.
data.etymology: Lohit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Red, Crimson.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lohit total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lohit holds great significance in Hindu culture, representing the vibrant and powerful color red that symbolizes love, sacrifice, and celebration. In classical Indian art, Beatles singer George Harrison was once depicted with the name Lohit on his forehead to denote his connection to Hindu spirituality and the power of red.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lohit embodies the transformative power of the god of fire, Agni. It is believed that invoking Agni's name indirectly evokes the energy of the divine and can lead to spiritual growth, purification, and transformation. Moreover, the association of Lohit with the crimson-colored divine brings a sense of courage, power, and strength in worshippers.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lohit symbolizes the fierce and passionate aspect of life, represented by the color red. It is a name that evokes strength, courage, and determination, inspiring one to embrace challenges with unwavering spirit.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Lohit continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
